authorization.next_required_action: One Director review of this corrected immutable no-update diagnostic package.

decision_mapping.H1_SUPPORTED: For both candidates, zero of five weak families are FIT_IMPROVED. This supports insufficient supervised fitting under the tested 100-step routes and may justify one new fitting-focused protocol review only.
decision_mapping.H2_STATUS: UNKNOWN. No gradient-direction conclusion is permitted.
decision_mapping.H3_SUPPORTED: H1 is false and at least one single candidate has FIT_IMPROVED plus DEV_NOT_IMPROVED in at least three of five weak families, with zero FIT_IMPROVED plus DEV_IMPROVED families for that candidate. This supports a train-to-DEV generalization bottleneck and may justify one new generalization-focused protocol review only.
decision_mapping.INCONCLUSIVE: All other outcomes, including mixed family evidence, numerical-drift failure, or missing binding verification. This closes the diagnostic branch; no successor protocol is selected post hoc.
decision_mapping.comparison_unit: Each of the two rejected candidates compared independently with V7 across the five weak families.

dev_join_contract.family_dev_improved: Candidate paired net fixes versus V7 >= +1 for that same family.
dev_join_contract.family_dev_not_improved: Candidate paired net fixes versus V7 <= 0 for that same family.
dev_join_contract.forbidden: Do not use DEV or retention labels in any NLL calculation.
dev_join_contract.source: The three immutable result records bound above, after NLL calculation completes.

execution_contract.fixed_batch1_crosscheck: First six scheduled rows per weak family in frozen schedule order (30 rows total).

numerical_drift_contract.failure: Any larger drift is NUMERICAL_DRIFT_FAIL and closes this diagnostic without interpreting fit classes.
numerical_drift_contract.fit_classification: FIT_IMPROVED only when candidate token-micro NLL <= V7 token-micro NLL - 0.01. Absolute difference < 0.01 is NO_MATERIAL_CHANGE. Candidate NLL >= V7 + 0.01 is FIT_WORSE.
numerical_drift_contract.rationale: 0.01 nats/token is prospectively ten times the permitted numeric aggregation drift, so numerical noise alone cannot create FIT_IMPROVED.
numerical_drift_contract.validation: On the fixed 30-row cohort, each condition must compare Batch1 with its effective batched execution and one repeated effective-batch forward pass. Per-family token-micro mean NLL absolute differences must be <= 0.001.

execution_contract.primary_estimator_definition: Sum token negative log likelihood over all non-ignored supervised labels in one family divided by that family supervised-token count.
execution_contract.secondary_estimator_selection_rule: Never used for the diagnostic-level decision.
execution_contract.tokenizer_and_label_masking: Use the frozen worker/tokenizer label construction; include exactly labels != -100.

frozen_train_cohort.allowed_use: Teacher-forced NLL only over non-ignored labels from the scheduled 400 TRAIN rows.

purpose: Immutable input binding for a no-update teacher-forced TRAIN-NLL diagnostic. It is not a training, generation, or checkpoint-selection authorization.
